# IRE Journals

> > IRE Journals is an open-access academic publishing platform for peer-reviewed research across engineering, nursing, and environmental sciences.

IRE Journals (Iconic Research and Engineering Journals) is a research publication platform based in India that facilitates manuscript submission, peer review, and publication of academic papers. The journal operates on an open-access model with processing charges and maintains a current publication schedule with regular issues.

## Manuscript Submission & Publication

- [Submit Research Paper](https://www.irejournals.com/submit-paper): Manuscript submission portal for research paper publication
- [Call for Paper 2026](https://www.irejournals.com/call-for-paper): Open call for paper submissions for March 2026 publication
- [Authors Guideline](https://www.irejournals.com/authors-guideline): Manuscript formatting standards and submission requirements
- [Processing Charges](https://www.irejournals.com/processing-charges): Publication fees in INR and USD for manuscript processing

## Current & Archived Issues

- [Current Issue - Volume 9 Issue 9](https://www.irejournals.com/current-issue): Current journal issue featuring latest published research papers
- [Past Issue List](https://www.irejournals.com/past-issue): Archive of previously published journal issues and volumes

## Published Research Papers

- [The Managerial Role of Software Architects: Translating Technical Vision into Organizational Execution](https://www.irejournals.com/paper-details/1714951): Published research paper on software architect management roles
- [Strategic Financial Visibility: Designing Real-Time Performance Architectures for Executive Decision-Making](https://www.irejournals.com/paper-details/1714975): Published paper on real-time financial reporting for executives
- [Determining The Concentration of Criteria Pollutants in Bonny Island from Industrial Activities](https://www.irejournals.com/paper-details/1713161): Published research on air quality assessment in Bonny Island
- [Health Risk Assessment of Human Exposures to Radiation Emanating from Radon in Groundwater from Parts of Damaturu Metropolitan Yobe State, Northeastern Nigeria](https://www.irejournals.com/paper-details/1713162): Published study on radon contamination in Nigerian groundwater
- [Fungi Associated with Post-Harvest Diseases of Different Species of Ripe Paw Paw (Carica Papaya)](https://www.irejournals.com/paper-details/1713165): Published research on fungal diseases affecting papaya crops
- [Should Petroleum, Alcohol, And Electricity Be Included Under GST?](https://www.irejournals.com/paper-details/1713188): Published research on GST taxation policy for India economy

## Peer Review & Editorial

- [Reviewer Application](https://www.irejournals.com/reviewer-add): Application form for peer reviewers and academic reviewers
